title: Newmark Hires Tim Lepore to Accelerate National Property Management Growth
summary: In his national role, Lepore will focus on growing Newmark's Property Management business through new client opportunities, expanded relationships and collaboration with the firm's Capital Markets and Agency Leasing teams.
